children: Forsyth Barr expects a strong set of 1Q operating statistics from New Zealand's electricity companies when they update the market later this month. It notes operating conditions in the wholesale electricity market are little changed, with renewable power generation breaking through 95% for the first time on a rolling 12-month basis. Still, rising interest rates and election uncertainty have weighed on the sector recently. New Zealand voters are due to go to the polls in November. Forsyth Barr's top picks in the sector are Contact Energy and Mercury NZ. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
